# Akashic Justice Analysis Template: Time to Disposition

This template provides a complete, pre-registered analysis of time to disposition (case processing time) across racial/ethnic groups, controlling for case characteristics.

## Usage

```r
# Source the core Akashic functions
source("akashicjustice.R")
source("disconfirmation.R")
source("pre_registration.R")

# Create template instance
template <- create_time_to_disposition_template(
  jurisdiction = "Your Jurisdiction",
  groups_of_interest = c("Black", "Hispanic"),
  include_pending = FALSE,
  controls = c("offense_severity", "charge_type", "case_complexity", "age_at_arrest")
)

# Render the analysis
render_time_to_disposition(template, data = your_cases, output_dir = "results")
```

---

## Template Structure

### 1. Pre-Registration

```r
template$pre_registration <- pre_registration_template()

# Set research question
template$pre_registration$research_question <- paste0(
  "In ", template$jurisdiction, ", do ",
  paste(template$groups_of_interest, collapse = "/"),
  " defendants experience longer time to disposition than ",
  template$reference_group, " defendants, controlling for case characteristics?"
)

# Set hypothesis
template$pre_registration$hypothesis <- list(
  statement = paste0(
    template$groups_of_interest[1], " defendants experience longer time to "
    "disposition than ", template$reference_group, " defendants, "
    "after controlling for offense severity, charge type, case complexity, and age at arrest"
  ),
  directional = "one.sided",
  alpha = 0.05
)

# Set outcome variable
template$pre_registration$outcome_variable <- list(
  name = template$outcome,
  definition = "Time to disposition in days (date of disposition minus date of arrest)",
  type = "continuous"
)

# Set predictor variables
template$pre_registration$predictor_variable <- list(
  name = "race_ethnicity",
  levels = c(template$reference_group, template$groups_of_interest),
  reference_level = template$reference_group,
  coding = "factor with levels ordered alphabetically"
)

# Set control variables
template$pre_registration$control_variables$controls <- list(
  offense_severity = list(
    description = "Severity level of the charged offense",
    type = "ordered factor",
    included = TRUE
  ),
  charge_type = list(
    description = "Type of offense",
    type = "factor",
    included = TRUE
  ),
  case_complexity = list(
    description = "Number of charges, counts of motions, number of witnesses",
    type = "count",
    included = TRUE
  ),
  age_at_arrest = list(
    description = "Defendant's age at time of arrest",
    type = "continuous",
    included = TRUE
  )
)

template$pre_registration$inclusion_criteria <- list(
  min_cases_per_group = 30,
  include_pending = template$include_pending,
  exclude_judicial_recusal = TRUE,
  exclude_appeal_pending = TRUE,
  exclude_cases_with_missing_arrest_date = TRUE
)
```

### 2. Analysis Plan

```r
template$pre_registration$analysis_plan <- list(
  method = "accelerated failure time (AFT) model with robust standard errors",
  model_formula = paste0(
    "Surv(0, disposition_day, event = disposition_day > 0) ~ race_ethnicity + ",
    paste(template$controls, collapse = " + ")
  ),
  software = "R 4.x+ with {survival, dplyr, broom, sandwich, survminer}",
  packages = c("survival", "dplyr", "broom", "sandwich", "survminer", "ggplot2"),
  estimation_method = "Weibull AFT model with HC1 robust standard errors",
  model_type = "survival analysis",
  dist = "Weibull"
)

template$pre_registration$significance_threshold <- list(
  alpha = 0.05,
  two.sided = TRUE,
  adjustment_for_multiplicity = "none",
  adjustment_method = "Single primary test"
)
```

### 3. Survival Specification

```r
template$survival <- list(
  time_var = "days_to_disposition",
  event = "disposition_occurred",
  event_definition = "Disposition = conviction OR acquittal OR dismissal",
  censoring = "Censored if: case still open, transfer, nolle prosequi",
  model_family = "Weibull",
  dist = "Weibull",
  link = "log",
  n_ties = "there are ties in survival times"
)
```

### 3. Effect Size Specification

```r
template$effect_size <- list(
  primary = "ratio of median survival times by race",
  standardized = "Hazard ratio from AFT model",
  interpretation = "HR > 1: longer time to disposition for groups_of_interest",
  quantile = "difference in median days to disposition"
)

template$additional_analyses <- list(
  "Kaplan-Meier curves" = "Plot median survival by group",
  "Log-rank test" = "Test equality of survival distributions",
  "Cox proportional hazards" = "Cox model (check PH assumption first)",
  "Spline modeling" = "Flexible modeling of time effects"
)
```

### 4. Disconfirmation Specifications

```r
template$disconfirmation <- list(
  # 1. Placebo test: should NOT find effect on non-case outcomes
  placebo = list(
    outcome = "incarceration_start_date",
    expected_null = TRUE,
    description = "Incarceration start should follow conviction date"
  ),
  
  # 2. Specification sensitivity
  specifications = list(
    "Cox model" = "Cox proportional hazards",
    "Exponential model" = "Exponential AFT",
    "Log-normal model" = "Log-normal AFT",
    "Kaplan-Meier medians" = "Just compare medians",
    "With court fixed effects" = "If multiple judges",
    "Without severe cases" = "Exclude felony cases"
  ),
  
  # 3. Negative controls
  negative_controls = list(
    list(outcome = "arrest_to_booking_time", reason = "Booking is administrative"),
    list(outcome = "time_between_charges", reason = "Unrelated to case processing")
  ),
  
  # 4. Alternative explanations
  alternatives = list(
    "Case complexity distribution" = TRUE,
    "Judge assignment pattern" = TRUE,
    "Prosecutor office" = TRUE,
    "Public defender assignment" = TRUE,
    "Geographic jurisdiction" = TRUE,
    "Temporal trends during pandemic" = TRUE
  )
)
```

### 5. Main Analysis Function

```r
template$run_analysis <- function(data, output_dir = "results") {
  # Save pre-registration
  save_pre_registration(template$pre_registration, file.path(output_dir, "pre_registration.rds"))
  
  # Prepare analysis data
  analysis_data <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(arrest_date), !is.na(!!rlang::sym(template$outcome))) %>%
    mutate(
      # Create survival object
      surv_time = as.numeric(!!rlang::sym(template$outcome)),
      event = ifelse(is.na(disposition_date), 0, 1),
      disposition_date = as.Date(disposition_date, origin = "1970-01-01"),
      arrest_date = as.Date(arrest_date, origin = "1970-01-01")
    ) %>%
    filter(surv_time >= 0)
  
  # Fit AFT Weibull model
  surv_obj <- Surv(time = analysis_data[[template$survival$time_var]],
                   event = analysis_data[[template$survival$event]])
  
  formula_str <- as.formula(template$pre_registration$analysis_plan$model_formula)
  aft_model <- survival::survreg(formula_str, data = analysis_data, dist = template$survival$dist)
  
  # Effect size: hazard ratio & median difference
  hr <- exp(-coef(aft_model)["race_ethnicityBlack"])  # HR for Black vs reference
  med_diff <- qweibull(0.5, scale = exp(-coef(aft_model)["(intercept)"])) -
              qweibull(0.5, scale = exp(-coef(aft_model)["(intercept)"] - coef(aft_model)["race_ethnicityBlack"]))
  
  # Run disconfirmation
  disconfirmation_result <- run_full_disconfirmation(
    data = analysis_data,
    analysis_function = time_to_disposition,
    analysis_spec = list(
      outcome = template$survival$time_var,
      group_var = "race_ethnicity",
      controls = template$controls,
      event = template$survival$event,
      censoring = template$survival$censoring
    ),
    placebo_specs = list(outcome = "arrest_to_booking_time"),
    negative_controls = c("arrest_to_booking_time", "time_between_charges"),
    time_var = template$survival$time_var
  )
  
  # Generate KM curves for report
  km_fit <- survfit(Surv(time = analysis_data[[template$survival$time_var]],
                         event = analysis_data[[template$survival$event]]) ~ race_ethnicity,
                    data = analysis_data)
  
  # Generate report
  report <- generate_pre_registration_report(template$pre_registration)
  writeLines(report, file.path(output_dir, "report.md"))
  
  return(list(
    primary = list(model = aft_model, surv_obj = surv_obj, hr = hr, med_diff = med_diff),
    disconfirmation = disconfirmation_result,
    km_fit = km_fit
  ))
}
```

---

## Expected Output

Running this template generates:

```
results/
├── pre_registration.rds
├── report.md
├── survival_analysis.rds
├── km_curves.png
└── disconfirmation_tests.rds
```

## Report Sections

1. **Research Question & Hypothesis** - From pre-registration
2. **Data Summary** - N, censoring rate, demographics
3. **Descriptive Statistics** - Median days to disposition by race
4. **Primary Analysis** - AFT Weibull model with HR
5. **Effect Size** - HR, median difference, CI, p-value
6. **Model Diagnostics** - PH assumption, AIC/BIC, residual checks
7. **Survival Curves** - KM plots by group
8. **Disconfirmation Testing** - All 6 falsification tests
9. **Comparison** - Pre-registered vs observed
10. **Limitations** - Censoring rate, follow-up time, confounders
